Exact numerical verification n<=229 and exponent<=64 corroborates but does not replace proof.

value.rationale: The least eventual-zero index modulo arbitrary dyadic moduli is a natural exact invariant of this published modular problem. It is computed for every exponent, with sharp boundary witnesses, and answers the four specific forbidden-residue families asked in the 2013 open question. It is a short deduction using known enumerative facts, not a broader groundbreaking theorem.
